conceptual_kernel.name: FEHLERBILD_EXACT_VS_SPIRAL
conceptual_kernel.same_world_constraint: EXACT and SPIRAL must return the same terminal; SAT witnesses from both proof-carrying lanes must replay on the same canonical CNF.
conceptual_kernel.epistemic_boundary: The CRT Fehlerbild is architectural inspiration, not evidence for algorithmic correctness, causality, or theorem truth.

discovery_not_validation.purpose: Find the first independently replayable positive-ROI examples for a selective spiral policy.
discovery_not_validation.future_requirement: Any discovered positive class must be frozen and tested on a later unexposed R5B holdout before routing authority can change.

sources: existing R0 TRUMP direct-challenge corpus roots
frozen_arena.note: R3/R4 material is intentionally allowed because R5 is discovery, not confirmatory validation.

frozen_spiral_policy.separator_choice: For size-1 candidates, evaluate every vertex structurally, choose the valid exact split maximizing min(|L|,|R|), tie-breaking by variable id. No SAT/UNSAT truth is queried during choice.
frozen_spiral_policy.proof_authority: Exact replay only. Structural choice has no truth authority.

work_accounting.spiral_total: pretruth signature_ops + all additional structural-search ops + boundary attempts + wing exact-search nodes + any fallback exact-search nodes
forbidden: Do not omit failed separator-search overhead.
Do not select a separator using truth or measured post-hoc cost.
Do not recolor zero or negative DELTA_W as a speedup.

gates.G1_PRETRUTH_SELECTION: all discovery rows and separator decisions are sealed before terminal truth
gates.G2_EXACTNESS: all compared lanes agree with independent exact DPLL where DPLL remains exact
gates.G3_SAT_REPLAY: every SAT result carries a replayable assignment
gates.G4_FEHLERBILD_DIFFERENCE: DELTA_W is recorded for every exact comparable row
gates.G5_NO_THEOREM_INFLATION: P_VS_NP remains OPEN regardless of ROI discoveries
